lessons.trigger_condition: two or more mutating autonomy invocations enter the V376 core concurrently before either process establishes exclusive ownership
lessons.prevention_rule: route the supported evolve entrypoint through a non-blocking OS file lock; concurrent or unsafe lock acquisition must fail closed before V376 is called or shared state/output is written; planning-only reads remain lock-free; preserve all V376 evidence, journal, neural, market, PR/CI, and physical-device boundaries
validation_required: mutating cycles acquire a non-blocking exclusive OS lock before invoking V376
lock contention does not invoke V376 and does not create the V376 execution journal
unsafe or unavailable lock fails closed
V376 evidence barrier, execution journal, verified learning, advisory neural, market freshness, and source-change PR/CI boundaries remain unchanged
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V377 serializes only the supported local mutating autonomy entrypoint; it does not widen autonomous actions, trust, model training, source writes, market inference, or physical-device claims
